To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-2022 to 2025-26 achieved in at least One financial years an average annual financial turnover in all classes of civil engineering construction works only of Rs 4.15 Lakhs

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-2022 to 2025-26 mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least Any Construction Work to an extent of Rs. 1.0375 Lakhs

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 1.245 Lakhs in the form of Credit lines or Letters of Credit or Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement Conditional bankers certificate not acceptable
